title: Bnei Yissaschar
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: Seminal 19th-century compilation of sermons, with an emphasis on the holidays, by Rabbi Tzvi Elimelech Spira of Dinov. Complete Chasidut text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Hasidic literature gathers sermons, letters and teachings from the movement's dynasties and schools. Individual works are attributed to specific rebbes and schools rather than to Chasidut as a whole.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
